title: Separate a reference from one recorded channel
incomingEvidence: R2B exact bounds only apply to supplied positive envelopes; reviewer requires testing practical mono extraction before using them. External measured RIR bytes remain unavailable after network approval cancellation.
question: Can fixed-frequency short-block harmonic regression separate a target and pilot in generated mono PCM, and can its rank/conditioning gate reject collisions?

model.design: four columns cos/sin at both declared frequencies; ordinary least squares separately for each nonoverlapping block
model.rateFit: OLS log-amplitude versus block-center physical seconds, centers between .05 and .95 inclusive
model.primaryFixture: smooth exponential amplitudes within each block
model.exactControl: piecewise constant carrier amplitudes equal analytic envelope at block center; this control isolates extraction from within-block model error

controls: bounded additive digital noise uniformly within +/-1e-4 FS before PCM quantization fixed seed; report effect separately
frequency collision reference=500Hz: rank2 in parameter domain4, explicit kernel witness, no separated correction
near collision reference=505Hz: reject if condition exceeds10; report condition and raw unconstrained diagnostic without identified correction
falsifier: Nominal reconstruction exceeds tolerance, collision is admitted, or a smooth-envelope fit error is falsely claimed to be bounded solely by digital quantization/noise.
claimCeiling: Finite generated mono-fixture extraction at known frequencies under stated window and condition gate; no arbitrary-audio mode discovery, physical witness validation, or empirical envelope-error bound.
loopA: Execute mono PCM extraction with exact-block and smooth controls; preserve model-mismatch diagnostics.
loopB: Independently decode and project mono samples, verify rank and collision witnesses, challenge frequency/window model.
